reproduction_target: Comparative-genomics / phylogenetics analysis of horizontally transferred cellulose biosynthesis gene clusters in E. coli: BLAST homolog retrieval from public NCBI + PLSDB sequences, multiple-sequence alignment, Maximum-Likelihood phylogeny (MEGA), transmembrane/domain prediction and visualization, plasmid typing (Center for Genomic Epidemiology servers), plasmid map/annotation display, and an R box plot of plasmid sizes. Wet-lab microbiology (strains, conjugation, cellulose/biofilm assays, cellulose extraction, TLC) is out of computational-reproduction scope.
granularity_note: Coarse one-step-per-named-tool from the 'Bioinformatic analyses' and 'Box plot calculation with R' Methods prose. GeneDoc manual curation is folded into the ClustalX alignment step; Prokka reannotation is folded into the Proksee display step; the three Center for Genomic Epidemiology typing servers (FimTypes / SerotypeFinder / PlasmidFinder 2.1) are one step. No code repository, scripts, commands, or config files are provided anywhere in the paper; every computational tool is invoked as an interactive GUI or web server with manual curation, so no executable artifact exists to read at stage-2. Wet-lab procedures counted in W, not verdicted.

steps.label: BLAST homolog search of BcsA1 (P37653) against NCBI microbial/complete/draft genomes + PLSDB plasmids (Altschul 1990); 'default parameters', query coverage >47% / 40%, truncated proteins removed
Multiple-sequence alignment with ClustalX 2.1, manually curated in GeneDoc (Higgins & Sharp 1988)
Identity/similarity calculation with 'Ident and Sim' (SMS2, bioinformatics.org) using aa classes GAVLI/FYW/CM/ST/KRH/DENQ/P (Stothard 2000)
Maximum-Likelihood phylogenetic trees with MEGA 7.0 or MEGA 11.0, 1000 bootstrap iterations (Tamura et al. 2021)
Gene-cluster comparative visualization with Easyfig (Sullivan, Petty & Beatson 2011); gene neighborhood assessed manually
Transmembrane-helix prediction with TMHMM (Moller, Croning & Apweiler 2001)
Transmembrane-topology prediction with TOPCONS (Tsirigos et al. 2015)
Domain-structure display with Illustrator for Biological Sequences IBS 2.0 (Xie et al. 2022)
Amino-acid-in-domain visualization with Protter (Omasits et al. 2014)
FimH type / serotype / origin-of-replication typing with Center for Genomic Epidemiology servers: FimTypes, SerotypeFinder, PlasmidFinder 2.1 (Carattoli & Hasman 2020)
Representative-plasmid display with Proksee (Grant et al. 2023), reannotated with Prokka (Seemann 2014)
Mean/median plasmid size + box plot (1st/3rd quartile) in RStudio version 4.4

headline.inference_inclusive_upper_bound: All 13 computational steps cap at NI even under inference-inclusive reading: no code repository, scripts, commands, or configuration are provided; every tool is an interactive GUI or web server and several key steps involve explicit manual curation (GeneDoc, manual gene-neighborhood assessment). Exact version pins exist for a minority of tools (ClustalX 2.1, ESPript 3.0, IBS 2.0, PlasmidFinder 2.1, RStudio 4.4) but with no executable artifact to attach them to. There is no stage-2 code to read; this paper does not become R★-eligible via stage2.
headline.coverage: 13 computational steps assessed from Methods prose; 6 wet-lab steps counted (W) but out of computational-reproduction scope. No code-availability or data-availability section present in the paper.

gaps.missing: No code repository, scripts, commands, notebooks, or configuration files are provided anywhere in the paper. Every computational tool is described as an interactive GUI/web-server invocation, several with explicit manual curation. Nothing is machine-executable/re-runnable.
gaps.how_to_close: Deposit an analysis repository (GitHub/Zenodo) containing the BLAST commands + thresholds, alignment/tree build scripts, input FASTA sets, and the R box-plot script, so the pipeline can be re-executed rather than manually re-clicked.

gaps.where: Software environment for all named tools
gaps.missing: No conda env, lockfile, container, or requirements. Version pins exist only for a partial subset (ClustalX 2.1, ESPript 3.0, IBS 2.0, PlasmidFinder 2.1, RStudio 4.4); BLAST, GeneDoc, Ident&Sim, Easyfig, TMHMM, TOPCONS, Protter, Proksee, Prokka are unversioned, and MEGA is ambiguous ('7.0 or 11.0').
gaps.how_to_close: Provide a pinned environment (conda-lock/pixi.lock or container digest) for the command-line tools; record exact versions and the resolved MEGA version.

gaps.where: C1 BLAST parameters; C5 MEGA model settings
gaps.missing: BLAST run with 'default parameters' (which BLAST program/matrix/e-value not stated); coverage thresholds given (>47%/40%) but per-search assignment unclear. MEGA substitution model / gamma settings unstated (only 1000 bootstrap given).
gaps.how_to_close: State the exact BLAST program and parameters, and the MEGA/ML substitution model and rate settings used per tree.

gaps.missing: The exact non-redundant homolog sets retrieved (accession lists, trimming coordinates, 'homologous regions common to all proteins') are not provided as machine-readable inputs; supplementary Tables S1-S3 list plasmid/protein accessions but not the curated alignment inputs.
gaps.how_to_close: Deposit the retrieved FASTA sets, curated alignments (with trimming coordinates), and tree files (e.g., in the analysis repo or a data archive).

gaps.where: Wet-lab: strains/growth, triparental conjugation, aggregation/cellulose/biofilm assays, Updegraff crystalline-cellulose extraction, 1% KOH extraction, cellulase-digest TLC
gaps.missing: Wet-lab generation/validation steps are out of scope for computational reproduction (OOS); counted in W, not verdicted.
gaps.how_to_close: N/A for Tier-1 computational readiness; scope is the bioinformatic analysis.
